turns.replyText:
Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?

Totally fair question, especially if money is tight.

Short answer: the cheaper one is absolutely a fine choice. The pricier one is only “worth it” if you really care about what it does extra for you.

Using the two I mentioned as an example:

Parfuma® Earth Angel is priced as a premium rose because of its:
Exceptionally strong, complex fragrance (lemon, champagne, raspberry, apple, classic rose)
Very full, peony-style blooms that look quite luxurious
Continual blooming habit once established

That “premium” is mostly paying for fragrance intensity and that very romantic, showpiece look.

If you:

Really love fragrance and want a “wow” centerpiece rose, the pricier option can feel worth the extra over time.
Just want a good, healthy, pretty rose that comes back every year, the cheaper one is usually the smarter move and will still be a good long-term investment.
